summary: Added an exact-upstream-EXE provenance census for the five guarded C2CSpeechBubbleGF/GF-heart spacing-only hook RVAs. The analyzer records 24 bytes at each hook plus the nearest known direct HUD/sprite CALL before and after within 0x80 bytes, emits JSON/Markdown/stdout evidence, and the backend disassembly verifier now requires the census contract. Exact CI evidence found no known direct HUD/sprite CALL within the bounded neighborhood of any of the five hooks, so no ScreenHud ownership was promoted and the existing spacing-only/negative guard remains unchanged.
